description: This Java class, UrlLoader, extends ResourceLoader and implements functionality to load resources from a URL, including resolving URL from a string and opening an InputStream for the resource.

classes.name: UrlLoader
classes.description: A class that loads resources from URLs by resolving string locations to URL objects and opening streams to these resources.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Resolves a string location to a URL object, handling URI syntax and malformed URL exceptions.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads a resource as an InputStream from the specified location URL.
